newsitem.title: USA: Number Nine offers duel monitor support.
newsitem.headline: Number Nine offers duel monitor support.

text.p: Number Nine Visual Technology Corp said Monday it was offering dual monitor support for users of both Windows NT 4.0 and NT 3.51 for Imagine 128 Series 2, the company's line of 128-bit graphic accelerators.
For users of Windows 95, Number Nine also introduced a new performance-enriched software display driver that pumps up Imagine 128 Series 2 graphics performance by as much as 25 percent.

Users of Windows NT wishing to have access to a larger Windows desktop can now install multiple Imagine 128 Series 2 boards into a single PC, thus doubling the available Windows desktop area. Each monitor has its own dedicated 128-bit graphics accelerator for maximum graphics performance. The dual-monitor driver makes the Imagine 128 Series 2 one of the first boards on the market to be able to span complex graphics, scientific and engineering data across two monitors at resolutions up to 1920 x 1200 on each screen for a total viewing resolution of 3840 x 1200.
Engineers began using dual monitors with the DOS versions of AutoCAD and MicroStation, two of the software packages on the market for computer-aided design.
